title: Cleaning of Personal Protective Equipment
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use the school's gumboots, gloves, aprons and dust coats. Each child has their own item; masks are never shared.

skills.key_step: The child names protective clothing (gumboots, gloves, apron, dust coat, overall, mask, hat) and what each protects (feet, hands, clothes, body, nose and mouth, head).

floor.prerequisite: Knows accidents happen at home and school.
floor.question: Name an accident in the garden.

steps: Say which part of the body it covers.

board.do: Draw a person in a garden.

misconceptions.repair: Hold each item up and say which body part it covers.

misconceptions.ask: Why does a farmer wear a face mask when spraying?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what would happen to a farmer who breathes in the spray.

misconceptions.ask: Which footwear protects a farmer in wet muddy ground?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what can cut or bite a bare foot in a shamba.
Splash water on an apron worn over a shirt; the shirt stays dry.

checks.question: What protects the hands when handling manure?
What does a dust mask protect?

skills.key_step: The child says how to clean and store protective clothing: remove dirt, wash with soap and water, rinse, dry fully in the open, store clean and dry, and never share masks or gloves.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the protective items and their use.
floor.question: What protects the feet in mud?

representations: a washing basin, soap and a brush
steps: Wash with soap and water; rinse.
Store clean and dry in your own place.
contexts: at the end of the week

board.do: Write "wet gloves put in a bag".
Ask what they will be like next week.

listen_for: Hang it away as it is
misconceptions.ask: What is done with a muddy apron after work?
misconceptions.repair: Smell a stored muddy apron after a week.

misconceptions.ask: How should washed gloves be stored?
misconceptions.repair: Pack away a damp cloth in a bag and smell it a week later.

misconceptions.ask: Two children want to use the same dirty gloves. What is best?
misconceptions.repair: Ask how germs and chemicals move from one hand to another.
Feel inside a boot left wet; it smells and stays damp.

checks.question: Why must gloves be dry before they are stored?
checks.answer: wet gloves grow mould and smell

checks.question: Why should masks not be shared?
checks.answer: germs pass from one person to another
